'''Senni Tonnika''' was a [[Gender|woman]] who, along with her sister [[Brea Tonnika|Brea]], formed the [[Tonnika sisters]], a duo of con artists.<ref name="CL 2016">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> At some point, Senni and Brea helped an associate break out of [[prison]].<ref name="You Owe Me a Ride">{{StoryCite|story=You Owe Me a Ride|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref>

==Biography==
Senni and Brea eventually came to meet [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and trashed their apartment on [[Coruscant]] to be on the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''. They also met [[Han Solo]], however he later betrayed and humiliated the sisters, ending their partnership.<ref name="You Owe Me a Ride" />

By [[1 BBY]],<ref name="ANH Date">{{FilmDate|IV|1}}</ref> shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin]], Tonnika and her sister were living on [[Tatooine]], but when [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba]] put a [[bounty]] on Solo, they went to [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]], a [[Cantina|drinking establishment]] located in [[Mos Eisley]]. She and her sister witnessed [[hermit]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] defending his [[Padawan|apprentice]] named [[Luke Skywalker]] and fight off two wanted crooks, wounding [[Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan]] and [[Dismemberment|dismembering]] [[Ponda Baba]]'s [[Limb|right arm]] before they decided not to collect Jabba's bounty, but to steal the ''Millennium Falcon'' so they could leave the planet, overhearing the ship was in [[Docking Bay 94]]. When they got to the bay they quickly had to hide as Jabba was there as well. They snuck out of the docking bay, and decided to steal another ship.<ref name="ANH" /><ref name="You Owe Me a Ride" />

==Personality and traits==
Senni Tonnika had black [[hair]], green [[eye]]s, and fair skin. Similar to that of her sister, she wore her hair in many braids. She and her sister wore similar catsuits.<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Senni was played by [[Angela Staines]] and Brea was played by actress [[Christine Hewett]].<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1545#16926420|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2007-09-26|time=5:34 PM|quote=Hewett was Brea... I mean Shada. Check out the Q&A of Insider #95 for the full answer.}}</ref> Christine and Angela were real life friends and were known during production as "Space Girls".<ref name="Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref>
